Bucket names for min_confidence

Source: R/predict.R
laya_bucket_keys.Rd

A per-bucket min_confidence gives a threshold per question type and option count. These are the valid names; "default" also applies to every bucket not named.

Usage

laya_bucket_keys()

Value

A character vector.

Examples

laya_bucket_keys()
#>  [1] "choice:2"    "choice:3-5"  "choice:6-10" "choice:11+"  "score:2"    
#>  [6] "score:3-5"   "score:6-10"  "score:11+"   "noul:2"      "noul:3-5"   
#> [11] "noul:6-10"   "noul:11+"
